description: Structured component registry converted from component-names.txt. Designed for model/tool loading to know which components exist, their source availability, variants, and inferred categories.

meta.category_method: rule-based keyword inference from component names; review before using as final ontology

category_labels.transportation_mobility: Transportation, mobility, road/public transit/bike related components
category_labels.public_safety_police_crime: Crime, police, petitions, or public safety related components
category_labels.fire_disaster_emergency: Fire, disaster risk, emergency response, AED, dangerous building components
category_labels.urban_development_land_housing: Urban renewal, land, housing, building permits, property components
category_labels.water_flood_weather: Water level, pumping station, flood, rainfall, stormwater components
category_labels.social_welfare_health: Elder care, welfare, medical, aging indicators components
category_labels.environment_green_public_space: Green space, trees, environment, waste, lighting, air-quality components
category_labels.demographics_employment: Population, age structure, employment estimation components
category_labels.childcare_birth: Childcare, parental leave, pregnancy/birth support components
category_labels.municipal_operations: Municipal work-order or operation management components
category_labels.uncategorized: No category inferred from current rules
